answer: Make throughput caps non-additive across linked identities. Each agent gets a per-epoch action budget, but the protocol merges budgets of any identities sharing a funding root or behavioral fingerprint into one pooled cap, reconciled each close. Spawning more keys buys no extra capacity: ten linked clones share the single budget one honest agent holds, so a sonnet of fake names collects nothing extra. An umber audit publishes each merge; a relic account reactivated to dodge it is re-linked on its first traced interaction. Attack value scales with distinct operators, not identities minted.
